item.title: Stilta raises $10.5M from a16z and YC to help companies rediscover the patents they forgot they had
item.description: Stilta is an AI platform designed to automate the research and analytical work behind intellectual property cases — the kind of labor-intensive work that has historically made patent litigation slow and expensive.

item.title: AI evaluation startup Braintrust confirms breach, tells every customer to rotate sensitive keys
item.description: Braintrust, a startup that makes an “operating system for engineers building AI software,” notified customers that hackers broke into one of its Amazon cloud environments, and is asking customers to rotate their API keys.

item.title: BMW i Ventures has a new $300M fund and AI is riding shotgun
item.description: BMW i Ventures is interested in startups working on agentic AI and physical AI, as well as industrial software, advanced materials, and manufacturing and supply chain technologies.

item.title: Cohere acquires, merges with Germany-based startup to create a ‘transatlantic AI powerhouse’
item.description: Cohere, the Canada-based AI company that makes AI tools for businesses in regulated industries, announced Friday it would merge with Aleph Alpha, a German company that also builds AI systems for businesses and governments.

item.title: Don’t stop hiring humans — stop hiring the wrong humans, Artisan’s founder says
item.description: Artisan may be known for their bold “Stop Hiring Humans” campaign but the reality is every founder needs to assemble the right team if they want to scale.

item.title: Esther and Anne Wojcicki back new healthcare accelerator, fund
item.description: Mary Minno launches early-stage startup accelerator program, Treehub, and an early-stage firm, AI Health Fund, aimed at backing startups working at the intersection of healthcare and AI.

item.title: It’s not just one thing — it’s another thing
item.description: This sentence construction ("It's not just this — it's that") has become so common in AI-generated writing that it's no longer just a clue that a piece of writing may be synthetic — it's almost a guarantee.

item.title: Roblox’s AI assistant gets new agentic tools to plan, build, and test games
item.description: The new tools are designed to help creators throughout the entire development process.

item.title: Accel raises $5B to back late-stage bets
item.description: Accel announced on Tuesday that it raised $5 billion in fresh capital to back late-stage companies building AI.

item.title: Stanford report highlights growing disconnect between AI insiders and everyone else
item.description: Stanford’s latest AI Index shows a widening gap between experts and the public, with rising anxiety over jobs, healthcare, and the economy.

item.title: At the HumanX conference, everyone was talking about Claude
item.description: Anthropic was the star of the show at San Francisco's AI-centric conference.

item.title: Florida AG announces investigation into OpenAI over shooting that allegedly involved ChatGPT
item.description: ChatGPT had reportedly been used to plan the attack that killed two and injured five at Florida State University last April. The family of one victim has said that they plan to sue OpenAI over the incident.

item.title: Anthropic debuts preview of powerful new AI model Mythos in new cybersecurity initiative
item.description: The new model will be used by a small number of high-profile companies to engage in defensive cybersecurity work.

item.title: Google Translate’s real-time headphone translations feature expands to iOS and more countries
item.description: The real-time headphone translations experience keeps each speaker’s tone, emphasis, and cadence intact, so it’s easier to follow the conversation and tell who’s saying what.

item.title: Google is launching Search Live globally
item.description: Search Live allows users to point their phone camera at objects to get real-time assistance, enabling back-and-forth conversations that draw on the visual context from the camera feed.

item.title: WhatsApp can now draft AI-generated responses based on your conversations
item.description: The Meta-owned messaging platform is also launching a way to free up space, the ability to touch up photos with Meta AI, and more.

item.title: After pivoting, Y Combinator grad Glimpse raises $35M led by a16z
item.description: Glimpse announced on Wednesday a $35 million Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, with participation from 8VC and YC.
